footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Flowco: includes an $842K income tax benefit; after $90.3M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $41.4M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 41.9% to $760M in 2025. Gross margin was 54.4%, versus 50.6% a year earlier, and operating income rose 27.6% to $149M, a 19.6% margin.
Net income fell 99.9% to $41K, or $1.24 per share. Operating cash flow was $294M and free cash flow $167M, versus $88.9M; Flowco returned $15.0M through buybacks.
watch: Net income includes a $842K tax benefit.
sources: Flowco Holdings Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
